qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Process know-how and qualification in high-end IC substrates and PCBs, but structurally lacks pricing power against dominant semi customers.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Highly capital-intensive PCB and IC substrate manufacturer suffering from severe customer concentration (AMD/Intel), weak pricing power, and depressed multi-cycle returns on capital exacerbated by heavy debt-financed capex in Malaysia.
qualitative.evidence: Depressed multi-cycle GAAP ROIC (<6% median) and extreme margin volatility. Capex-heavy manufacturing model with massive debt-funded capacity expansions in Kulim, Malaysia and Leoben, Austria. Customer power is overwhelmingly concentrated among a few dominant semi giants (AMD, Intel, Apple), leaving AT&S as a price-taker unable to earn its cost of capital across the cycle.
